teaser.en: Unlike most seagrasses, it grows woody stems that rise from the seabed, carrying fans of curved leaves like little underwater palms.
teaser.sw: Tofauti na nyasi bahari nyingi, huotesha mashina magumu kama mti yanayoinuka kutoka sakafu ya bahari, yakibeba mapepeo ya majani yaliyopinda kama minazi midogo chini ya maji.
teaser.dg: Si dza nyasi zinji za bahari, ihi inamera mihi migumu dza ya muhi inayoima kula tsini ya bahari, na dzulu kuna makodza ganayootyoka ganayoenea dza chiphephero, dza mihi midide ya jamii ya minazi ndani ya madzi.

summary.en: Sickle-leaved seagrass is one of the two most common seagrasses in Kenya, forming dense meadows on the sandy and rocky floors of the lagoons. Its meadows shelter the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani kama mundu (*sickle-leaved seagrass*) ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari mbili zinazopatikana kwa wingi zaidi nchini Kenya, ikiunda mbuga zilizosongamana kwenye sakafu za mchanga na miamba za mahori. Mbuga zake huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.
summary.dg: *Sickle-leaved seagrass* ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi mbiri za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya, na inahenda phatu phenye nyasi nyinji zirizobanana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga na ya mawe ya madzi machache ga bahari. Phatu phenye nyasi hizi phanafitsa ng'onda na pweza ambao avuvi a pwani anaakuluphira.

about.en:
Sickle-leaved seagrass is a flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. It is sturdier than most seagrasses: tough, woody stems rise from the seabed, each topped with a fan of flat, curved leaves shaped like a sickle. A meadow of it looks like a tiny underwater forest of palms.

Its strong roots and creeping rhizomes can grip rock as well as sand, so it can grow where other seagrasses cannot.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani kama mundu ni mmea unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Ni imara zaidi kuliko nyasi bahari nyingi: mashina magumu kama mti huinuka kutoka sakafu ya bahari, kila moja likiwa na pepeo la majani bapa yaliyopinda kama mundu juu yake. Mbuga yake inaonekana kama msitu mdogo wa mimea ya jamii ya mnazi chini ya maji.

Mizizi yake imara na viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) vyake vinavyotambaa vinaweza kushika mwamba pamoja na mchanga, hivyo inaweza kuota mahali ambapo nyasi bahari nyingine haziwezi.
about.dg:
*Sickle-leaved seagrass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Ina nguvu kuriko nyasi zinji za bahari: mihi migumu dza ya muhi inaima kula tsini ya bahari, na kpwenye ntsa ya chila muhi kuna makodza dza utepe ganayootyoka, ganayoenea dza chiphephero, ga umbo ra mundu (*sickle*). Phatu phenye nyasi hino phanaonekana dza tsaka dide ra mihi ya jamii ya minazi ndani ya madzi.

Miziye yenye nguvu na mihi inayoambala tsini ya mtsanga inaweza kugbwira mawe na mtsanga, kpwa hivyo inaweza kumera phatu nyasi zanjina zisiphoweza.

where.en: It forms dense meadows on sandy and rocky lagoon bottoms and is one of the two predominant seagrasses on the Kenyan coast. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. It usually stays under water, so snorkellers in the lagoons see it best.
where.sw: Huunda mbuga zilizosongamana kwenye sakafu za mchanga na miamba za mahori na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari mbili zinazotawala katika pwani ya Kenya. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Kwa kawaida hubaki chini ya maji, hivyo wanaopiga mbizi kwa kutumia mrija katika mahori ndio huiona vizuri zaidi.
where.dg: Inahenda phatu phenye nyasi nyinji zirizobanana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga na ya mawe ya madzi machache ga bahari, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi mbiri za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi pwani ya Kenya. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Kpwa kawaida inasala ndani ya madzi, kpwa hivyo atu anaoojorera kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari ndio anaoiona vinono zaidi.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is sickle-leaved seagrass, and its scientific name is *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, which means 'sea tree'.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *sickle-leaved seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, lenye maana ya 'mti wa bahari'.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *sickle-leaved seagrass*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, rinalomaanisha 'muhi wa bahari'.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.
conservation.dg: Nyasi za bahari za Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni phatu pha kurya pha nguva, kasa a chijani na tsafi, na ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda adide.

reason.dg: Nyasi yanjina ya bahari inayophahikana zaidi Kenya
